definitions.explanation: Four children born together from a single pregnancy. From {四|よ}つ (four) plus {子|こ} (child), which voices to ご.

examples.japanese: {四|よ}つ{子|ご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四|よ}つ{子|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
{四|よ}つ{子|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's very hard to tell the quadruplets apart.

notes:
{四|よ}つ (four) plus ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child); こ voices to ご in the compound.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧: twins
- {三|みつ}つ{子|ご}: triplets
- ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧{子|ご}: quintuplets

USAGE:
These multiple-birth words use the native counting series (⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧, {三|みつ}つ{子|ご}, {四|よ}つ{子|ご}, {五|いつ}つ{子|ご}), not the Sino-Japanese numbers.
